models.name: ROXXY BL-Smart Control 940-6 SV (8573)
models.firmware_note: Burst 45 A; BEC 5-7.4 V, 5 A (type not stated); NiCd/NiMH 6-18 cells; S.BUS2 telemetry

entry.confirm_signal: Long beep about 4 s after power-up, melody (5-6-5) about 4 s later.
steps: Receiver connected, transmitter on, throttle forward (full).
Connect power: after about 4 s a long beep.
Parameters then sound in a loop.

announce.description: Parameter N is N beeps, looping through 1 to 8. Inside a parameter the options loop the same way: option N is N beeps.

select.description: Select a parameter by moving the stick to the stop position while its beeps sound. Select an option by moving to full throttle while its beeps sound; a 5-6-5 melody confirms.

skip.description: Do nothing while a parameter's beeps repeat; the loop moves on.

scheme.confirm_signal: Melody 5-6-5 after an option is stored; the parameter loop then continues.
scheme.exit: Parameter 8 (8 beeps), then stick to stop: melody 6-5-6; switch the ESC off.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Parameter 7 (7 beeps) resets all data; the sub-menu behaviour is not described.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up gives a long beep after about 4 s and melody 5-6-5 after 4 s more. Parameters 1 to 8 loop as 1 to 8 beeps. Stick to stop while the wanted parameter sounds opens its options (N beeps for option N); full throttle stores the option with melody 5-6-5. Parameter 8 exits.

items.name: Cutoff voltage
items.note: LiPo 3.0/3.1/3.2 V per cell; NiCd/NiMH 25%/50%/60% of start voltage (minimum 4.6 V); LiFe 2.5/2.8/2.9 V per cell.

unknowns: Beep duration and gaps: not stated.
Defaults are read from grey table cells in the page image; text does not state them.
Reset (parameter 7): how confirmation is given and whether a sub-menu is sounded: not stated.
Exit (parameter 8): the manual says to leave via 8 beeps and then stop stick; the melody 6-5-6 is stated, any wait is not.
Stick to stop selects a parameter; whether a sub-menu starts at option 1 immediately: not stated.
Program Card (accessory 85731000) offers brake force 0/25/50/75/100%, cutoff soft/hard/off, start mode, timing, acceleration and governor; none of this is available from sticks.
notes: The stick menu has 3 brake force values (off, 50%, 100%); the Program Card table has 5 values (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%).
The stick menu offers three start-up modes (normal, soft, super soft); the Program Card names them normal, medium, soft.
announce.repeat 0 means the sequence repeats until a choice is made (manual: "continuous").
